applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Locate the transaction's recorded return reason. If it is unavailable, submit the transaction ID and details for investigation.

| Reason | Local handling |
|---|---|
| `DUE TO ACCT CLOSED` | Confirm account status with the recipient bank and use another account. |
| `OUT OF OPERATION` | Contact the recipient. |
| `Internal Policy`, `RR04 REGULATORY REASON`, `RTN RSN AS PER BBK RQST`, `RC07` | Obtain further details from the recipient bank. |
| `BENEFICIARY DETAILS MISMATCH` or `RTN RSN ACC NOT HELD` | Check the recipient's bank information. |
| `AS REQUESTED DETAILS NOT RECEIVED` | A new payment can be attempted; respond promptly to any new bank information request. |
| `Beneficiary Bank Name is not valid. It contains invalid characters` | Replace the relevant spaces in the beneficiary or bank name with standard half-width English spaces. |
| Other standard reasons | Obtain the specific reason from the bank. |

For `REASON CANCELLED BY CHATS` or `FALSE HIT CONFIRMATION AFTER CHATS CUTOFF`, use the separate CHATS support investigation during the first three business days after the return. After three business days, an alternative receiving account may be used for a new attempt once the actual returned funds are confirmed. Acceptance remains subject to the bank's processing.

If a same-name withdrawal was returned because the registered holder names differ, verify the names and submit the appropriate name-update evidence. Re-create an incorrect recipient where the affected field cannot be edited.
